newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche to create authorised capital.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche to create authorised capital.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Thursday it plans to create 500 million marks of authorised capital and 300 million marks of conditional capital.
The bank said in an invitation to its annual shareholders' meeting on May 20 that it would ask shareholders to entitle management to issue up to 500 million marks of new shares by April 30, 2002.
The bank said the move was aimed at enabling it to adjust its equity capital to future business requirements.
The 300 million marks in conditional capital will entitle the management to issue up to three billion marks of profit participation certificates, warrant and convertible bonds by April 30, 2002.
